payload.title: Exploring EPICA Dome C records with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of Pyleoclim for analyzing paleoclimate data from the EPICA Dome C ice core. It focuses on loading and visualizing deuterium and CO2 data, applying spectral analysis techniques such as Lomb-Scargle periodogram and wavelet analysis, and assessing memory properties of the time series. The notebook also explores singular spectrum analysis to clean the data and compares temperature and CO2 records. The outputs include visualizations of spectral properties, coherence between datasets, and statistical significance tests.
